declarations.name: CholeskySolve.CholeskyRun.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} {u : Real} {rnd : Real → Real} {A R : CholeskySolve.Mat n},
  (∀ (i j : Fin n), LT.lt.{0} j i → Eq.{1} (R i j) 0) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin n),
        LT.lt.{0} i j → CholeskySolve.updateValid u rnd (A i j) (R i i) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R i j)) →
      (∀ (i j : Fin n),
          LT.lt.{0} i j →
            Eq.{1} (R i j) (CholeskySolve.update rnd (A i j) (R i i) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R i j))) →
        (∀ (j : Fin n), CholeskySolve.subDotValid u rnd (A j j) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R j j)) →
          (∀ (j : Fin n), LT.lt.{0} 0 (CholeskySolve.subDot rnd (A j j) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R j j))) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n),
                CholeskySolve.RoundOK u rnd
                  (Real.sqrt (CholeskySolve.subDot rnd (A j j) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R j j)))) →
              (∀ (j : Fin n),
                  Eq.{1} (R j j)
                    (rnd (Real.sqrt (CholeskySolve.subDot rnd (A j j) (CholeskySolve.choleskyTerms R j j))))) →
                CholeskySolve.CholeskyRun u rnd A R

declarations.name: CholeskySolve.cholesky_solve
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} (u : Real) (rnd : Real → Real) (A : CholeskySolve.Mat n) (b : CholeskySolve.Vec n) (R : CholeskySolve.Mat n)
  (y x : CholeskySolve.Vec n),
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) 1) u) 1 →
      Eq.{1} (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} A) A →
        Matrix.PosDef.{0, 0} A →
          CholeskySolve.SolveRun u rnd A b R y x →
            ∃ ΔA,
              And (Eq.{1} (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA) x) b)
                (And
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (CholeskySolve.gamma u n)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.absMatrix (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (CholeskySolve.absMatrix R) i j)))
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0}
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (CholeskySolve.gamma u n)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.absMatrix (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (CholeskySolve.absMatrix R) i j))
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 3 (CholeskySolve.gamma u (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)))
                          (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.gamma u n) 2))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (CholeskySolve.absMatrix (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R))
                          (CholeskySolve.absMatrix R) i j))))
